overview_description.description: Orchid Labs is an open-source project committed to ending surveillance and censorship on the internet. Orchid uses an overlay network built upon the existing internet, which is driven by a peer-to-peer tokenized bandwidth exchange, creating a more inclusive, liberated internet. Orchid Labs was founded in 2017 by Dr. Steven Waterhouse, Jay Freeman,  Brian J. Fox, Gustav Simonsson, and Stephen Bell.

product.name: Orchid VPN
product.description: A decentralized, pay-as-you-go VPN protocol that allows users to pay only for the bandwidth they use without subscriptions.

product.name: Orchid Accounts
product.description: Accounts funded with various tokens to send nanopayments for services on the Orchid platform.

product.name: Nanopayment Ecosystem
product.description: A system enabling extremely small payments with minimal transaction fees for services on Orchid’s platform.

product.name: Preferred Provider Directory
product.description: A decentralized directory that connects users randomly to preferred service providers within Orchid’s marketplaces.

product.name: Orchid Staking
product.description: A mechanism where providers stake OXT tokens to compete for user payment flow in Orchid’s decentralized marketplace.

product.name: OXT Token
product.description: Orchid’s native ERC-20 token used for staking and payments within the decentralized marketplace.
